open Complex Filter Function Metric Finset
open scoped BigOperators Topology

theorem exercise_3_4 (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) :
    Tendsto (λ y => ∫ x in -y..y, x * Real.sin x / (x ^ 2 + a ^ 2))
    atTop (𝓝 (Real.pi * (Real.exp (-a)))) := by sorry
